AddReminderIntent.title: Add a reminder
AddReminderIntent.description: Starts a new reminder for the reminders page. Home hub then asks when it is due.

SetDueTimeIntent.title: Give the due time
SetDueTimeIntent.description: Adds the reminder with a due time. A day by itself means 9 in the morning, and a time by itself means the next time the clock shows it.

NoDueTimeIntent.title: Skip the due time
NoDueTimeIntent.description: Adds the reminder without a due time. Saying "no" does the same.

ListRemindersIntent.title: Hear what's due
ListRemindersIntent.description: Reads out the unfinished reminders that are due today or overdue.
